purpose: Execute the already-defined E01 horizontal peer-node claim against H-A, H-B and H-C under one line and parent. The run measures shared Node/Relation/Context paths, Realm/Membership/Scope/Capability/resource isolation, rollback-safe writes, and one shared source/build/artifact identity. This record mirrors the active E2.0 trace matrix and does not create or expand a product contract.

implementation_basis.role: Production shared Node and NodeRelation model
Production shared NodeContext and indexed scope resolvers
Production Membership, Scope and Capability adapters

regression_basis.role: Existing shared NodeContext and scope regression

environment_classification: A successful clean-source replay of all production migrations in a disposable PostgreSQL 17 environment, followed by the complete locked E01 matrix and one shared runtime build, can establish DEV VERIFIED only. It is not a stable staging or production observation.

source_inventory_scope.node_specific_definition: A scoped production-source path or source line containing the generated E01 run token, a generated peer node/Realm/Scope/resource identifier, or a conditional branch comparing a node identifier to H-A, H-B or H-C.

prelocked_thresholds: exactly H-A, H-B and H-C share one line, one L0 parent and signed level L1; H-A/H-B are Hosted and H-C is Sovereign
all three contexts match their authoritative Node, Relation, Realm and Scope rows and use one model and parser-path identity
node_id, Realm, Account, Membership, Scope and resource distinct counts each = 3
nine positive operation decisions match the prelocked expectations, including the data-driven H-A/H-C allow and H-B deny capability probe
all 30 Realm/Membership/Scope/Node/resource cross-node read/write requests are denied with zero business rows and zero Outbox rows
exactly three positive writes update only their own authoritative resource rows, append 39 expected decision-audit rows and three expected Outbox rows
unexpected authoritative-table, audit or Outbox diff count = 0 and transaction rollback residual fact count = 0
one source SHA, one build invocation, one build ID and one immutable artifact identity serve all three peers
source_copy_count, node_specific_source_file_count, node_name_business_branch_count and node_specific_build_count each = 0
negative oracle mutation detection miss count = 0
positive_cases: Resolve H-A, H-B and H-C through PgAuthoritativeNodeContextResolver and the shared parseAuthoritativeNodeContext path.
Execute the same read and rollback-safe write operation for all three peers against their own Realm, Membership, Scope and resource.
Execute one identical capability probe whose H-A/H-C allow and H-B deny result is determined solely by the peer entitlement row.
Build one commerce-api runtime artifact and assign its single identity to all three peers.
negative_cases: For every peer and both read/write operations, replace in turn the Realm endpoint, Membership, Scope, Node and resource with the next peer's value.
Verify every cross-node request is denied, emits no Outbox event and cannot read or modify any business row.
Scan the locked production-source scope for peer-name conditionals, generated fixture identifiers and node-specific source copies or builds.
Mutate independent-oracle input copies by swapping one context Scope, admitting one cross-node write and adding a second artifact identity.

independent_oracle.procedure: Read the locked criteria and eight required raw artifacts only; independently reconstruct the expected three-peer topology and authority map; compare every context and all 39 operation observations; derive allowed capability decisions from raw entitlement state; count exact resource/audit/Outbox diffs and rollback residuals; recount model/parser symbols, scoped production-source identifiers, build provenance, artifact file hashes and three peer assignments; mutate copies of context, cross-node operation and artifact inputs to prove detection. Do not consume a runner PASS/status field.

unknown_rule: Missing any peer topology row, authority row, context field, operation request/decision, authoritative before/after/rollback snapshot, source/model inventory, build invocation, artifact file hash, peer assignment, environment fact or source-basis digest yields UNKNOWN.

outcome_table.condition: All required raw artifacts exist and all prelocked topology, shared-model/path, identity, operation, isolation, authoritative-diff, rollback, source/build/artifact and mutation-detection thresholds are met.
Any complete raw observation contradicts a prelocked topology, context, operation, isolation, authoritative-diff, rollback or shared-artifact threshold.
Any required raw artifact or field is missing, unreadable or cannot be independently reconciled.

review_classification: The criteria designer, executor and oracle operator are the same Codex task; the result remains NOT REVIEWED until a reviewer independent of the E01 implementation, fixture and oracle recomputes and signs it.
